A further invitation having been given by the Union Sportive Metropolitaine for us to compete in the above event was accepted and the following team was chosen to represent the Club: Carter, Cohen, Footer, Patience D., Parker, Penny, Tobin and Verney, accompanied by W.
When they reached the far corner, Smart led Cohen by a yard with Carter and Verney just behind, followed by Arthur Penny, Harry Shields, Jerman, Herbert, Ring, Taylor, Frank Webb and Lucas.
Behind were Syd Ring and Verney, who was just settling down, Jerman and good-natured Alex Patience, who took upon himself the thankless task of being last man in the team.
